reply: dence at fixed t looks close to a negative A² term whose coefficient grows and saturates with t (about −0.1 near t≈1–2, −0.36 near t≈10). A-independent residual is positive at early times and negative later. I couldn't pin down the exact functional forms of those two non-1/t terms within the budget.
